It is anchored by a long narrative in verse set in Tilbury Town, following an eccentric, destitute philosopher named Captain Craig as observed by a young narrator and his friends. Through talk, letters, and character sketches, it meditates on truth, art, faith, failure, and the stubborn spark of joy amid want.
